compare_weights: compare the weights of a float PyTorch model with its quantized counterpart using their state dicts
compare_model_outputs: compare output activations between a float model and its quantized version for the same input data
compare_model_stub: compare quantized modules with their float shadow counterparts using a module swap list and input data
prepare_model_with_stubs: prepare a quantized model by attaching float shadow modules and a logger class for specified module types
get_matching_activations: find and match activation tensors between a float model and its quantized version after logging
